svg.aria-label: MJH Risk Monitor (ClarusRisk Dashboard): Risk monitoring and portfolio management for institutional asset managers. 150+ REST endpoints, 40+ controllers, 243 domain entities, 5 regulatory frameworks. Access & tenancy: SAML 2.0 single sign-on, JWT, permission-based auth, RBAC across tenants. API layer: ASP.NET Core on .NET 10, Clean Architecture, Redis caching layer. Risk & compliance: VaR, liquidity stress tests, PRIIPS · AIFM · SFDR, UCITS · MiFID II reporting. Real-time & delivery: Live portfolio monitoring, SignalR · Hangfire on Redis, PDF pipeline, SFTP delivery.
